items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the New York state urban development corporation act, in relation to the regional revolving loan program
items.lawSection: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S4046

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the New York state urban development
corporation act, in relation to the regional revolving loan program

 PURPOSE OF BILL :

This bill would allow the Empire State Development Corporation (ESDC)
to administer the Regional Revolving Loan Trust Fund Program, Minority
and Women Revolving Loan Trust Fund Program, Micro Enterprise
Revolving Loan Trust Fund and Commercial District Revolving Loan Trust
fund in a manner consistent with the small business revolving loan
fund program.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1 of the bill would amend § 16-a of the Urban Development
Corporation Act (UDC) by adding a new subdivision 3-a that would
authorize the Empire State Development (ESDC) to administer the
Regional Revolving Loan Trust Fund Program in a manner consistent with
the small business revolving loan fund program.

Section 2 of the bill would amend § 16-a (20) of the UDC to require
the ESDC to submit annual reports relating to the Regional Revolving
Loan Trust Fund Program and post them on their websites.

Section 3 of the bill would amend § 16-c of the UDC by adding a new
paragraph (I) that would authorize the ESDC to administer the Minority
and Women Revolving Loan Trust Fund Program in a manner consistent
with the small business revolving loan fund program.

Section 4 of the bill would amend subdivision three of § 16-c of the
UDC by adding two new paragraphs (d) and (e) that would authorize the
ESDC to administer the Micro Enterprise Revolving Loan Trust Fund in a
manner consistent with the small business revolving loan fund program
and to submit annual reports.

Section 5 of the bill would amend subdivision 8 of § 16-d of the UDC
is amended by adding two new paragraphs (g-1) and (k-1) that would
authorize the ESDC to administer the Commercial District Revolving
Loan Trust fund in a manner consistent with the small business
revolving loan fund program.

Section 6 of the bill would amend subdivision 14 of § 16-d of the UDC
is amended by a new paragraph (c) that would require the ESDC to
submit annual reports relating to Commercial District Revolving Loan
Trust fund and post them on their websites.

Section 7 of the bill would amend subdivision 14 of § 16-t of the UDC
to require the ESDC to submit annual reports relating to the Small
Business Revolving Loan fund Program and post them on their websites.

Section 8 of this bill is the effective date.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2015-16: A.7517-A/S.5494-A
2014: A.10065

 STATEMENT IN SUPPORT :

This bill would allow the ESDC to administer the Regional Revolving
Loan Trust Fund Program, Minority and Women Revolving Loan Trust Fund
Program, Micro Enterprise Revolving Loan Trust Fund and Commercial
District Revolving Loan Trust fund in a manner consistent with the
small business revolving loan fund program. This will allow ESDC
greater flexibility to structure transactions that more closely meet
changing market requirements, while still servicing the types of
businesses that all of the Revolving Loan Fund Programs are intended
to benefit.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to the State.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This bill would take effect immediately.

summary: Authorizes the empire state development corporation to administer several revolving loan fund (RLF) programs in a manner consistent with how the small business revolving loan fund is administered.
title: Relates to the administration of the regional revolving loan fund program
